epics.title: Project management and OpenAPI contract
epics.notes: Implement the Project management HTTP surface (POST/GET /projects, GET /projects/{id}) backed by local SQLite, plus confirm the auto-generated GET /openapi.json contract.

epics.title: Implementation Plan: Issue lifecycle CRUD
epics.notes: Implement the full Issue CRUD HTTP surface (POST/GET/GET-by-id/PATCH/DELETE /issues) with server-assigned per-project sequential keys, extending the existing FastAPI scaffold shipped by the project-management spec.

epics.title: Fixture seed data
epics.notes: On a fresh database, seed exactly one Project (ASSIST) and six Issues spanning all statuses/types/priorities, with real canon names and canon-reconciled identifiers, and never seed again once any Project row exists.

epics.title: Kanban board view, project switcher, and project creation
epics.notes: Ship a same-origin kanban board UI (three fixed columns, project switcher, create-project form) as static assets served by issue-tracker-api's own FastAPI process, no build step, no framework.

epics.title: Issue create, edit, delete, and column move
epics.notes: Extend the kanban board with create/edit/delete forms for Issues and a column-move interaction, backed by issue-tracker-api's issue-lifecycle endpoints, with optimistic-then-reconcile for the drag move and a shared revert/error path for every mutation.

epics.title: Project MCP tools (list_projects, create_project)
epics.notes: Stand up a new mcp_server/ package exposing list_projects and create_project as MCP tools that thinly wrap issue-tracker-api's GET/POST /projects endpoints.

epics.title: Issue MCP tools (list/get/create/update/delete)
epics.notes: Extend mcp_server/ with list_issues, get_issue, create_issue, update_issue, and delete_issue MCP tools thinly wrapping issue-tracker-api's Issue endpoints, matching project-tools' established client/error/tool-registration conventions.

epics.title: Docker packaging and run instructions
epics.notes: Package issue-tracker-api and mcp-server into two Dockerfiles plus a docker-compose.yml, wired with a named volume for the SQLite file and a PORT/API_BASE_URL/DATABASE_PATH env-var convention, with run instructions in the README/CLAUDE.md.

epics.title: Implementation Plan: End-to-end API test suite (real HTTP)
epics.notes: Validated: PASS (2026-09-06) | Report: .context-index/specs/features/issue-tracker-api/api-e2e.validate.md | Tests: PASS (105 fast + 44 JS + 11 e2e). Confidence: LOW — adev verify issue could not match this epic's plan_ref (known field-naming bug: epic store uses planRef, verifier expects plan_ref; already reported, non-blocking). Manual close recommended: adev issues close epic-7q32wl --reason "validated, all tasks implemented".

epics.title: End-to-end UI test suite (real browser) implementation plan
epics.notes: Add a real-Chromium Playwright e2e suite (BEH-1..6 + network-failure error path) driving kanban-ui's actual served page against the real issue-tracker-api server, reusing the api-e2e fixture with its own isolated server instance.

epics.title: End-to-end MCP test suite (real client/transport)
epics.notes: Add a real-client, real-transport e2e suite driving mcp-server's already-implemented tools over streamable-http, cross-verified against issue-tracker-api via real HTTP.

epics.title: Visual design refresh — dispatch-board identity
epics.notes: Restyle kanban-ui's board/forms into a ticket/dispatch-board visual identity (ink/rail/paper palette, priority-striped cards, system font stacks only), zero functional/DOM-hook change.

epics.title: User MCP tools (list_users, create_user)
epics.notes: Wrap issue-tracker-api's new /users endpoints as list_users/create_user MCP tools, mirroring project-tools' pattern, for full mcp-server user-management parity.

epics.title: User picker in issue forms
epics.notes: Auto-fills the assignee field in create/edit-issue forms from issue-tracker-api's User directory; free-text field unchanged, no schema change.

epics.title: Backlog list view and issue filters
epics.notes: Add a Backlog list/table view and a shared assignee/type/priority filter bar to kanban-ui, purely client-side.

epics.title: Issue comments and activity log
epics.notes: Add a per-Issue Comment activity log across issue-tracker-api, kanban-ui, and mcp-server.

epics.title: Sprints
epics.notes: Add Sprint entity/lifecycle, Issue.sprint_id, kanban-ui Sprint view, and mcp-server tools. Task 4 blocked on backlog-view's implementation.
